name: planning
description: Plan-driven workflow over a separate plans repository. /pln captures what is being discussed as a durable, committed plan and holds planning mode; /oimpl creates the worktree, attaches it to the plan and opens a session for the work; /impl validates the plan and executes it with a delegated team; /ipln runs the same conversation but files the result as issues in the repository's own tracker, drafted locally and posted only on an explicit go-ahead; /rewrt consumes the marker notes written into files; /migrate-pln moves an old working-tree PLAN.md into the plans repository; /archive-sessions files the conversations that produced a piece of work into the vault.
